title: Iron Man / X-O Manowar in Heavy Metal
overview:
Metal titans, Iron Man and X-O Manowar, come together for the first time ever to tackle one heavy-duty cosmic crisis! It's an apocalyptic meltdown of furious action, with the ultimate in Super Hero power and realism!

Suit up as Marvel's Iron Man or the armored warrior X-O Manowar in this side-scrolling action game, alone or with a friend. Fly, blast and brawl your way through eight missions, from a nuclear plant siege and Stark Enterprises to the streets of New York, Arnim Zola's castle and an alien dig site, battling super-villains such as Titania, Melter, Mr. Hyde, Absorbing Man and Baron Zemo.

- Bi-directional firepower and Iron Man's chest beam blasts
- Multi-hit combos and Z-axis shooting
- Power up your weapons
- Huge boss battles and an asteroid-dodging space stage
- 1 or 2 players
